proposition: Melvin-Koushki reports that the fact that the manifestation of level seven belongs to the present time, marked by a celestial conjunction, was communicated to Ibn Turka by his teacher Sayyid Ḥusayn Akhlāṭī; the treatise elsewhere credits 'our Sayyid' with explaining what the earlier thinkers could not.

mediation.who: Melvin-Koushki, paraphrasing or translating Ibn Turka's own work
mediation.note: the pages do not name the conjunction or date the communication; Akhlāṭī is dated d. 1397 in the Prologue, so the timing is unexplained
